classes.name: Warden
classes.leans: Protecting a party; holding a wall

options.name: Shield the line
options.text: A party member's failed beat lands on you instead

options.name: Hold fast
options.text: Hold options one band better on a wall or in a doorway

options.name: Stand over
options.text: A downed party member cannot lose their haul while you stand

options.name: Braced kit
options.text: Armour loses half the durability from failed beats

options.name: Rally
options.text: Once per encounter, the whole party's next option is one band better

options.name: Wall-captain
options.text: Your won beats count double toward raid defence

options.name: Unmoved
options.text: You cannot be the second failure that downs a party

options.name: Bulwark
options.text: A settlement you are in treats its wall as one tier higher

classes.name: Stalker
classes.leans: First strikes; following tracks; ambushing the ambushers

options.name: First strike
options.text: Your first option in an encounter is one band better

options.name: Read the ground
options.text: Tracks stay readable for 12 ticks, not 6

options.name: Turn the ambush
options.text: An ambush on you gives you the first beat

options.name: Quiet feet
options.text: Cover counts 20 higher for you

options.name: Mark prey
options.text: Name one creature tag per day; one band better against it

options.name: Ghost trail
options.text: You leave no tracks

options.name: The long hunt
options.text: A creature that fled can be followed to its tile

options.name: Cull
options.text: Your won beats remove 4 threat, not 2

classes.name: Smith
classes.leans: Narrower appraisal; a second method per process

options.name: Steady hand
options.text: Appraisal ranges are half as wide

options.name: Thrift
options.text: Station fees are halved

options.name: Third method
options.text: Each process you practise gains one more method

options.name: Salvager
options.text: Failed combinations return 50%, not 30%

options.name: Maker's stamp
options.text: Items you make gain xp 10% faster for anyone

options.name: Reforge
options.text: Move up to 10 pts between two axes of an item, once

options.name: Master's eye
options.text: You see whether a recipe is registered before committing

options.name: Signature
options.text: One kind you discovered costs you no station fee, ever

options.name: Packer
options.text: +10 load

options.name: Road sense
options.text: Ambush chance one band lower on road tiles

options.name: Fresh news
options.text: Prices from elsewhere are half as old for you

options.name: Haggler
options.text: Faction orders pay you 3% more

options.name: Convoy
options.text: A party following your route shares your ambush band

options.name: Bonded
options.text: Haul goals you take need half the collateral

options.name: Factor
options.text: Hold 40 open orders, not 20

options.name: Caravan-master
options.text: Mounts in your party need no upkeep on the road

classes.name: Delver
classes.leans: Forks, locks, leaving with the haul

options.name: Light fingers
options.text: Lockpick options one band better

options.name: Sure footing
options.text: Hazard beats one band better

options.name: Mapper
options.text: Both ways down at a fork show their next beat's tags

options.name: Pack light
options.text: Leaving a dungeon never costs a turn

options.name: Deep breath
options.text: A second failure below floor 3 leaves you wounded, not down

options.name: Key-maker
options.text: Make a key for a dungeon you have reached the bottom of

options.name: The way back
options.text: Carry a downed character up without a beat per floor

options.name: Hoard-sense
options.text: The spoils pool of a floor is shown before you enter it

classes.name: Kindler
classes.leans: Exploit states lasting longer; a second exploit slot

options.name: Lingering
options.text: States your exploits add last one beat longer

options.name: Tinder
options.text: Compile costs one component fewer, at least 2

options.name: Second slot
options.text: Carry a second deck

options.name: Wide cast
options.text: An exploit's state reaches one more creature
options.waits: MM8 (more than one creature an encounter)

options.name: Counter
options.text: Remove one state tag from a creature or ally per encounter

options.name: Storm-reader
options.text: You see every system's path a full world day ahead

options.name: Bind the weather
options.text: Once a season, hold a weather tag on a tile for 3 world days

options.name: Chain
options.text: A state you add triggers its rule twice
options.waits: MM8 (more than one creature an encounter)

classes.name: Reeve
classes.leans: Cheaper listings; larger musters; guild works costing less

options.name: Fair hand
options.text: Listing fees are 3% of the reward, not 5%

options.name: Crier
options.text: Goals you post are shown first on the board for a day

options.name: Quartermaster
options.text: Guild works you fund use 10% less stock

options.name: Surveyor
options.text: You see a tile's generated fields before founding there

options.name: Muster
options.text: A pooled goal you post needs 1,500 coin pledged, not 2,000

options.name: Even shares
options.text: A pooled goal you post may pay everyone equally instead of by contribution

options.name: Founder
options.text: Charters cost your guild half

options.name: Steward
options.text: A settlement you serve loses one fewer structure to a lost trouble
